import numpy as np
from cvxpy import matrix_frac, Variable, quad_form
import cvxpy as cp

np.random.seed(42)

# Create matrix X with shape (3, 2) - this is the case where the bug manifests
n, p = 3, 2
X_val = np.random.randn(n, p)
P_val = np.eye(n) + np.random.randn(n, n)
P_val = P_val.T @ P_val  # Make P positive definite

# Create the expression
X = Variable((n, p))
P = Variable((n, n), PSD=True)
expr = matrix_frac(X, P)

# Compute the gradient at the test point
X.value = X_val
P.value = P_val

# Analytical gradient computation
grad_X = expr.grad[0]  # Gradient w.r.t. X
grad_P = expr.grad[1]  # Gradient w.r.t. P

# For finite differences, we compute the gradient numerically
eps = 1e-5
fd_grad_X = np.zeros((n, p))

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(p):
        X_plus = X_val.copy()
        X_plus[i, j] += eps
        X.value = X_plus
        P.value = P_val
        f_plus = expr.value
        
        X_minus = X_val.copy()
        X_minus[i, j] -= eps
        X.value = X_minus
        P.value = P_val
        f_minus = expr.value
        
        fd_grad_X[i, j] = (f_plus - f_minus) / (2 * eps)

X.value = X_val
P.value = P_val

# Compute the error between analytical and finite-difference gradient
if grad_X is not None:
    error = np.linalg.norm(grad_X - fd_grad_X) / (np.linalg.norm(fd_grad_X) + 1e-10)
    probe('gradient_error', error)
    probe('max_absolute_error', np.max(np.abs(grad_X - fd_grad_X)))
    probe('has_nan_in_analytical', np.any(np.isnan(grad_X)))
else:
    probe('gradient_error', np.nan)
    probe('max_absolute_error', np.nan)
    probe('has_nan_in_analytical', 1)
